history.summary: A young (2022) freehold 4BR of just 1033 sqft at $2130 PSF / $2.2M in D20 Bishan/Ang Mo Kio fringe, 1.53km from Mayflower MRT. The appreciation rate carries a new-launch bias flag, the only resale-only figure is missing, and 1033 sqft is very tight for a genuine 4BR.
history.rating_rationale: 1033 sqft for a 4-bedroom is exceptionally compact — these are 'shrunk' efficiency 4BRs that struggle on family resale and command a premium PSF ($2130, near the $2144 median) without the livability. The 3.8% rate carries a new-launch-bias flag and has no resale-only counterpart, so forward growth is uncertain. Poor MRT access (1.53km / 18-min walk) and a sub-500 score (486) compound the case. Overpriced compact 4BR with weak connectivity — Avoid.
